Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date of the charge for the product or service associated with the line item.

Time.name: Time
Time.definition: Time of the charge for the product or service associated with the line item.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of product or service associated with the line item.

OtherType.name: Other Type
OtherType.definition: Other type of product or service associated with the line item.

PostCheckOut.name: Post Check Out
PostCheckOut.definition: Indicates whether or not the charge originated following the checkout.

CreditDebit.name: Credit Debit
CreditDebit.definition: A code to indicate the tax amount is credit or debit

UnitAmount.name: Unit Amount
UnitAmount.definition: Contains the cost for one unit of the product or service.

SubTotalAmount.name: Sub Total Amount
SubTotalAmount.definition: Subtotal amount of line item.  (e.g. total nightly rate, etc.)

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Taxes related to the products or services.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
